title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
summary: A Bayesian wearable-data fit generated prospective predictions for one athlete; two sealed paired comparisons ran opposite to the model’s prediction, while the follow-up still could not identify a stable long-term fitness time constant.
ai_technology: A Bayesian model fitted wearable measurements to generate prospectively testable predictions about an individual athlete’s physiology.
